EC1: Heart Team assessment of operability [AND] (the heart team considers the patient to be a good surgical candidate).
EC2: Evidence of an acute myocardial infarction = 1 month (30 days) before the intended treatment [defined as: Q wave MI, or non-Q wave MI with total CK elevation of CK-MB = twice normal in the presence of MB elevation and/or troponin level elevation (WHO definition)].
EC3: Untreated, severe, left sided valvular heart disease including mitral [OR] regurgitation [OR] or stenosis, and aortic [OR] regurgitation or stenosis.
EC4: Mean pulmonary artery pressures =40mmHG and PVR >4 woods units [AND] as assessed by right heart catheterization.
EC5: Any therapeutic invasive cardiac procedure [AND] resulting in a permanent implant [AND] that is performed within 30 days of the index procedure. Examples of permanent implant would include any new heart valve. Implantation of a [NOT] permanent pacemaker is excluded.
EC6: Patients with planned concomitant surgical [OR] or transcatheter ablation [AND] for Atrial Fibrillation.
EC7: Leukopenia [OR] (WBC < 3000 cell/mL), acute anemia [OR] (Hgb < 9 g/dL), Thrombocytopenia (Plt < 50,000 cell/mL).
EC8: Hemodynamic [OR] or respiratory instability requiring inotropic support [OR], mechanical ventilation [OR] or mechanical heart assistance within 30 days of screening evaluation.
EC9: Need for emergency surgery for any reason.
EC11: Echocardiographic evidence of intracardiac [OR] mass, thrombus or vegetation.
EC12: Active upper GI bleeding within 3 months (90 days) prior to procedure.
EC13: A known contraindication [OR] or hypersensitivity [OR] to all anticoagulation regimens, or inability [AND] to be anticoagulated for the study procedure.
EC14: Recent CVA [OR] clinically confirmed (by neurologist) or neuroimaging [AND] confirmed stroke [OR] or transient ischemic attack (TIA) within 6 months (180 days) of the procedure.
EC15: Estimated life expectancy < 1 year from conditions other than TR.
EC16: Expectation that patient will not improve despite treatment of tricuspid regurgitation
EC17: Currently participating in another investigational cardiac device study or any other clinical trial, including drugs or biologics. Note: Trials requiring extended follow-up for products that were investigational, but have since become commercially available, are not considered investigational trials.
EC18: Active bacterial endocarditis within 6 months (180 days) of procedure.
EC19: Patients with signs or symptoms of SVC syndrome [OR], or hepatic cirrhosis [AND] not felt due to passive congestion from TR.
